$comment: handcrafted for spec 036 — upstream SAP abap-file-formats only ships a type-pool schema (type-v1.json), not a table-type. Mirrors the SAP ADT ttyp:tableType XML contract.
title: Table Type Properties
description: ABAP table type (TYPE ... TABLE OF ...) properties

accessType.title: Access Type
accessType.description: Table type access kind: standard / sorted / hashed

lineType.title: Line Type
lineType.description: Either rowType (refers to a data type / structure / table / table type, or a predefined DDIC data type such as CHAR / STRING) or rowStructure (inline fields).

rowType.title: Row Type Reference
rowType.description: Row type name: a repository type (data element / structure / table / table type) or a DDIC predefined data type name (CHAR, NUMC, DEC, DATS, INT4, STRING, ...).

rowTypeLength.title: Row Type Length
rowTypeLength.description: Length of a predefined row type (ADT ttyp:length). Ignored for a repository row type, whose length SAP derives from the referenced object.

rowTypeDecimals.title: Row Type Decimals
rowTypeDecimals.description: Decimals of a predefined row type (ADT ttyp:decimals); only meaningful for DEC / CURR / QUAN and the decfloat types. Ignored for a repository row type.

keyDefinition.title: Key Definition
keyDefinition.description: Keys (required only for sorted / hashed access types).

keyKind.title: Key Kind
keyKind.description: Uniqueness of the primary key when keyDefinition is set (ADT ttyp:primaryKey/kind). Optional: push defaults to unique for hashed tables, nonUnique otherwise.

rows.title: Initial Rows
rows.description: Optional default rows (rare for table types).
